items.title: Association Between Early Postoperative Limb Symmetry Index Scores and 2-Year Patient-Reported Outcomes After Quadriceps Tendon Autograft ACL Reconstruction.
items.summary: A case series of 100 patients after quadriceps tendon autograft ACL reconstruction found that 3-month isometric quadriceps LSI strongly predicted 2-year IKDC scores (β = 3.9; adjusted R² = 0.36; P < .03), and 9-month isokinetic quadriceps LSI strongly predicted both Lysholm and IKDC scores (β = 3.9-4.7; adjusted R² = 0.34-0.35; P ≤ .003).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，股四头肌肌腱自体移植ACL重建术后早期（3个月）的等长股四头肌肢体对称指数（LSI）和9个月的等速股四头肌LSI与2年患者报告结局（PROMs）显著相关。这提示您在康复早期应重视股四头肌力量恢复，并利用LSI作为指导康复和预测远期功能恢复的重要指标。
items.titleZh: 股四头肌肌腱自体移植ACL重建术后早期肢体对称指数与2年患者报告结局的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对100名股四头肌肌腱自体移植ACL重建术后患者的病例系列研究发现，3个月时等长股四头肌LSI强烈预测2年IKDC评分（β = 3.9; adjusted R² = 0.36; P < .03），9个月时等速股四头肌LSI强烈预测Lysholm和IKDC评分（β = 3.9-4.7; adjusted R² = 0.34-0.35; P ≤ .003）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that early (3-month) isometric quadriceps LSI and 9-month isokinetic quadriceps LSI are significantly associated with 2-year PROMs after QT-ACLR. This suggests you prioritize early quadriceps strength recovery and utilize LSI as a crucial metric for guiding rehabilitation and predicting long-term functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性病例系列，证据等级为4级，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在混杂因素未完全控制。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective case series (Level 4 evidence), which cannot establish causality and may have unaddressed confounding factors.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=75) compared HILT+UNGE, ESWT+UNGE, and UNGE alone for post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome. Both HILT and ESWT improved nerve conduction and upper-limb function more than UNGE alone (all P < .001). HILT produced significantly greater improvements than ESWT across electrophysiological outcomes and DASH scores, with benefits maintained at 12-week follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT发现，高强度激光疗法（HILT）联合尺神经滑动练习（UNGE）在改善烧伤后肘管综合征的神经电生理和上肢功能方面优于体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）联合UNGE或单独UNGE。这提示您在临床上处理这类患者时，可以优先考虑HILT作为物理治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后肘管综合征高强度激光疗法与体外冲击波疗法联合尺神经滑动练习的电生理和功能反应：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对75名烧伤后肘管综合征患者的随机对照试验，比较了HILT+UNGE、ESWT+UNGE和单独UNGE的疗效。结果显示，HILT和ESWT均比单独UNGE更能改善神经传导和上肢功能（均P < .001）。HILT在电生理和DASH评分上均优于ESWT，且效果在12周随访时仍保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that High-Intensity Laser Therapy (HILT) combined with ulnar nerve gliding exercises (UNGE) was superior to Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy (ESWT) combined with UNGE, or UNGE alone, for improving electrophysiological and upper-limb functional outcomes in post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome. This suggests you may prioritize HILT as a physical therapy option for these patients in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 随访期仅12周，长期疗效尚不明确，且研究人群为烧伤后肘管综合征，结果外推至其他病因的肘管综合征需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up period was only 12 weeks, so long-term efficacy is unclear. The study population was specific to post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome, limiting generalizability to other etiologies.

items.title: Physical performance clustering as a marker of frailty, fall risk, and cognitive health in older adults
items.summary: An unsupervised classification study of 368 older adults identified three physical performance clusters (High, Moderate, Low), which differed significantly across most physical performance measures, especially muscular power and joint moments. The Low Physical Performance group included more frail individuals and fallers, supporting the utility of this clustering for identifying at-risk subgroups.
items.curatedReason: 该研究通过物理表现测量（PPMs）聚类，将老年人有效分层为高、中、低身体表现组，发现肌力（muscular power）和关节力矩（joint moments）是区分这些组的最具判别力的特征。这提示您在评估老年患者时，应更重视肌力和关节力矩的测量，以早期识别衰弱和跌倒风险，指导精准康复干预。
items.titleZh: 老年人身体表现聚类作为衰弱、跌倒风险和认知健康标志物
items.summaryZh: 一项针对368名老年人的非监督分类研究识别出三种身体表现聚类（高、中、低），这些聚类在大多数身体表现测量指标上，特别是肌肉力量和关节力矩方面存在显著差异。低身体表现组包含更多衰弱个体和跌倒者，支持该聚类方法在识别高风险亚组中的效用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study effectively stratified older adults into high, moderate, and low physical performance groups using physical performance measure (PPM) clustering, finding that muscular power and joint moments were the most discriminative features. This suggests that when assessing older patients, you should prioritize measuring muscular power and joint moments to identify frailty and fall risk early, guiding precise rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，不能建立因果关系，且记忆抱怨在各组间无显著差异，提示该聚类方法在认知健康方面的区分度有限。
items.limitationEn: This observational study cannot establish causality, and the lack of significant differences in memory complaints across groups suggests limited discriminative power for cognitive health.

items.title: Can Psychological Readiness Predict Successful Return to Sports After Patellar Stabilization Surgery in Adolescent Patients? A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study of 97 adolescent patients found that an ACL-RSI score ≥59.2 was associated with an increased likelihood of successful return to sport (OR, 3.56; 95% CI, 1.10-11.51; P = .033) after patellar stabilization surgery, independent of sex or injury characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 该研究证实，青少年髌骨稳定手术后，ACL-RSI 量表得分 ≥59.2 是成功重返运动的独立预测因子。这提示您在评估青少年患者重返运动准备情况时，应将心理准备度纳入考量，并可将 ACL-RSI 量表作为重要工具。
items.titleZh: 心理准备度能否预测青少年髌骨稳定手术后成功重返运动？一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对97名青少年患者进行的回顾性队列研究发现，髌骨稳定手术后ACL-RSI量表得分≥59.2与成功重返运动的可能性增加相关（OR, 3.56; 95% CI, 1.10-11.51; P = .033），且与性别或损伤特征无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study confirms that an ACL-RSI score ≥59.2 is an independent predictor of successful return to sport after patellar stabilization surgery in adolescents. This suggests you should include psychological readiness, using the ACL-RSI scale, in your assessment of adolescent patients' readiness to return to sport.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且为单中心研究，可能存在选择偏倚和结果的外推性限制。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study is single-center, which may introduce selection bias and limit the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Effectiveness of conservative interventions on pain and disability in degenerative cervical spine disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (2,378 participants) found conservative interventions were associated with significant reductions in pain (SMD = -0.67; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.37; I² = 87.20%) and disability (SMD = -0.60; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.24; I² = 91.56%) in degenerative cervical spine disease, with acupuncture and exercise-based interventions showing benefit, but manual therapy showing no significant pooled benefit. The certainty of evidence was low.
items.curatedReason: 保守治疗对退行性颈椎病有帮助，可以缓解疼痛和改善功能，尤其是针灸和运动。但请注意，手法治疗没有显著的汇总效益，而且总体证据确定性很低。向患者解释时，要如实说明证据的局限性，别夸大疗效。
items.titleZh: 保守干预对退行性颈椎病疼痛和功能障碍的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入18项随机对照试验（2378名参与者）的系统综述和Meta分析发现，保守干预与退行性颈椎病患者的疼痛（SMD = -0.67; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.37; I² = 87.20%）和功能障碍（SMD = -0.60; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.24; I² = 91.56%）显著减轻相关。其中针灸和运动干预显示益处，但手法治疗的 pooled 益处不显著。证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Conservative interventions help with degenerative cervical spine disease, alleviating pain and improving function, especially acupuncture and exercise. However, note that manual therapy showed no significant pooled benefit, and overall evidence certainty is low. When explaining to patients, be truthful about the evidence limitations and don't overstate efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的RCT数量有限，保守治疗干预措施异质性高，且证据确定性低（low certainty of evidence），限制了结论的强度和特异性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included RCTs, high heterogeneity of conservative interventions, and low certainty of evidence limit the strength and specificity of the conclusions.

items.title: Physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access in a referral-based system in Austria - A qualitative study.

items.title: Sex differences in performance fatigability: evidence from a maximal intermittent protocol using a flywheel device (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD abstract investigates sex differences in the mechanisms underlying performance fatigability following a maximal intermittent fatiguing protocol using a flywheel device, focusing on performance decline, voluntary muscle activity, and electrically-evoked mechanical/electromyographical variables.
items.curatedReason: 这篇博士论文摘要探究了最大间歇性协议下，男女在运动疲劳表现上的性别差异。这提示您在制定训练和康复方案时，应考虑生理性别对疲劳机制的影响，以优化个性化干预策略。
items.titleZh: 表现疲劳的性别差异：来自使用飞轮设备的最大间歇协议的证据（博士学术奖）
items.summaryZh: 这篇博士论文摘要研究了使用飞轮设备进行最大间歇性疲劳协议后，表现疲劳机制的性别差异，重点关注表现下降、自主肌肉活动以及电诱发机械/肌电变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD abstract investigates sex differences in performance fatigability during maximal intermittent protocols. This suggests that when designing training and rehabilitation programs, you should consider the influence of biological sex on fatigue mechanisms to optimize individualized intervention strategies.

items.title: Development of an upper and lower limb athlete pain assessment framework (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD abstract outlines the development of a stakeholder-informed upper and lower limb athlete pain assessment framework to enhance clinician/researcher and athlete interaction by comprehensively assessing pain through a multidimensional, biopsychosocial lens.
items.curatedReason: 这篇博士论文摘要旨在提出一个利益相关者知情的上下肢运动员疼痛评估框架。这提示您在临床实践中，应更全面地评估运动员的疼痛，整合生物、心理、认知和社会环境等多维度因素，以提升疼痛管理的有效性。
items.titleZh: 上下肢运动员疼痛评估框架的开发（博士学术奖）
items.summaryZh: 这篇博士论文摘要概述了开发一个利益相关者知情的上下肢运动员疼痛评估框架，旨在通过多维度生物心理社会视角全面评估疼痛，以增强临床医生/研究人员与运动员的互动。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD abstract aims to propose a stakeholder-informed framework for assessing upper and lower limb pain in athletes. This suggests that in clinical practice, you should comprehensively assess athlete pain, integrating biological, psychological, cognitive, and socio-environmental factors to enhance the effectiveness of pain management.

items.title: Percutaneous Electrolysis for the Management of Musculoskeletal Disorders. A Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 13 trials found that adding percutaneous electrolysis (PNE) to therapeutic exercise (TE) was not superior to sham plus TE or TE alone for pain or function in tendinopathies. Low-certainty evidence suggested PNE combined with TE might offer greater short- to medium-term pain reduction compared to dry needling plus TE in tendinopathy, but not in myofascial pain syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 针对肌腱病变，电解疗法（PNE）联合运动治疗在短期至中期疼痛缓解上可能优于干针联合运动治疗，但在功能改善或肌筋膜疼痛综合征中未显示优势。你应审慎考虑其在临床实践中的应用，不作为一线选择。
items.titleZh: 经皮电解疗法治疗肌肉骨骼疾病：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含13项试验的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，在肌腱病变中，经皮电解疗法（PNE）联合治疗性运动（TE）在疼痛或功能方面不优于安慰剂或单独TE。有低确定性证据表明，PNE联合TE在短期和中期疼痛缓解方面可能优于干针联合TE，但在肌筋膜疼痛综合征中无此优势。
items.curatedReasonEn: For tendinopathy, percutaneous electrolysis (PNE) combined with therapeutic exercise may offer short- to medium-term pain benefits compared to dry needling plus exercise, but shows no superiority in function or for myofascial pain syndrome. Exercise caution when integrating PNE into clinical practice, and do not prioritize it as a first-line treatment.
items.limitation: 证据确定性非常低至低，主要结果未显示PNE优于安慰剂或单独运动治疗。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence ranged from very low to low, and main results did not show superiority of PNE over sham or exercise alone.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A multicenter randomized controlled trial found that a smartphone-based multidisciplinary intervention combining personalized exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy significantly improved pain, function, quality of life, and psychological well-being in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain. This digital therapeutic offers a scalable and cost-efficient delivery of care aligned with clinical guidelines.
items.curatedReason: 这款数字疗法结合了运动和认知行为疗法，在缓解慢性髌股疼痛方面效果显著。这提示你，数字化、多学科的干预方案是解决患者依从性和心理社会因素的有效途径，值得在临床实践中关注并考虑采纳。
items.titleZh: 数字疗法结合运动和认知行为疗法可减轻慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验发现，结合个性化运动和认知行为疗法的智能手机数字多学科干预显著改善了慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛、功能、生活质量和心理健康。这种数字疗法提供了一种符合临床指南的可扩展且经济高效的护理模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This digital therapeutic, combining exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy, significantly reduces chronic patellofemoral pain. This suggests that digitized, multidisciplinary interventions effectively address patient adherence and psychosocial factors, making it a valuable approach to monitor and potentially integrate into your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究未明确长期随访结果，且患者对数字平台的依从性数据未充分披露。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly state long-term follow-up results, and patient adherence data to the digital platform were not fully disclosed.

items.title: Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation Improves Motor Function of Upper Extremity in Adults with Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercises led to significant improvements in Fugl-Meyer Assessment for Upper Extremity (FMA-UE: MD = 3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69) and shoulder/elbow muscle strength in chronic ischemic stroke patients compared to sham taVNS.
items.curatedReason: 经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）可能改善慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢运动功能和肌肉力量。但在推广此技术前，应注意其FMA-UE评分的临床最小重要差异（MCID）边界效应。
items.titleZh: 经皮迷走神经刺激改善慢性缺血性卒中成人上肢运动功能：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，与安慰剂组相比，经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）结合上肢运动能显著改善慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢Fugl-Meyer评估（FMA-UE: MD = 3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69）和肩肘肌肉力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (taVNS) may improve upper-limb motor function and muscle strength in patients with chronic ischemic stroke. Before widely adopting this technique, be mindful of the marginal effect size compared to the minimal clinically important difference (MCID) for FMA-UE scores.
items.limitation: FMA-UE的95%置信区间低于报告的临床最小重要差异，提示临床意义可能有限。
items.limitationEn: The 95% CI for FMA-UE was below the reported minimal clinically important difference, suggesting potentially limited clinical relevance.

items.title: Sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb field tests in elite TeamGym gymnasts.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 216 elite TeamGym gymnasts established sex- and age-specific normative values for ankle dorsiflexion, hop for distance, height-adjusted hop for distance, side-hop, and heel-raise performance. Significant sex × age-group interactions were observed for hop outcomes, with senior males outperforming junior males and senior females showing no age-group differences.
items.curatedReason: 本研究为精英 TeamGym 体操运动员提供了首个分性别、年龄的下肢功能表现常模值，这对你评估和指导体操运动员的康复及重返赛场具有重要的参考价值。
items.titleZh: 精英 TeamGym 体操运动员下肢场地测试的性别和年龄特异性常模值
items.summaryZh: 一项对216名精英 TeamGym 体操运动员的横断面研究建立了踝关节背屈、跳远、调整身高跳远、侧跳和提踵表现的性别和年龄特异性常模值。跳跃结果中观察到显著的性别×年龄组交互作用，其中高级组男性表现优于初级组男性，而女性则无年龄组差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides the first sex- and age-specific normative values for lower-limb functional performance in elite TeamGym gymnasts, which is highly valuable for your assessment and guidance in rehabilitation and return-to-sport decisions for these athletes.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法评估随时间变化的性能变化或预测损伤风险。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, unable to assess performance changes over time or predict injury risk.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Graft type is not associated with revision ACL reconstruction in football players: a nationwide cohort analysis of subsequent ACL reconstructions
items.summary: A nationwide cohort analysis of more than 10 000 football players who underwent ACL reconstruction found that graft choice (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) was not associated with the risk of revision ACL reconstruction among players who returned to competition, in either women or men.
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性队列研究表明，在重返赛场的足球运动员中，ACL重建的移植物类型（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱自体移植物）与再次ACL重建的风险无关。这意味着你在选择移植物时，可以更多地考虑患者特征和手术偏好，而不是过分担忧再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 移植物类型与足球运动员的翻修性前交叉韧带重建无关：一项全国性队列分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对超过 10 000 名接受前交叉韧带（ACL）重建的足球运动员的全国性队列分析发现，对于重返赛场的运动员，移植物类型（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱自体移植物）与再次ACL重建的风险无关，无论是男性还是女性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This nationwide cohort study indicates that graft type (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) is not associated with the risk of revision ACL reconstruction in football players who return to competition. This means you can prioritize patient characteristics and surgeon preference when selecting grafts, rather than overemphasizing reinjury risk.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是“再次ACL重建”而非“再次ACL损伤”，可能低估了实际的再损伤率。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on "revision ACL reconstruction" rather than "subsequent ACL injury," which might underestimate the actual reinjury rate.

items.title: Effect of Integrated Respiratory and Functional Training on Weaning from Mechanical Ventilation, Respiratory and Peripheral Muscle Strength, Functional Ability, and Pain After Emergency Abdominal Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the effect of integrated respiratory and functional training on weaning from mechanical ventilation, respiratory and peripheral muscle strength, functional ability, and pain after emergency abdominal surgery. The study aims to address respiratory impairment and prolonged hospitalization common in these patients.
items.curatedReason: 急腹症术后患者的康复方案，现在可以考虑加入综合呼吸和功能训练了。这项RCT提示，这种整合方案可能有助于更早脱离机械通气，改善肌肉力量和功能，甚至减轻疼痛，从而缩短ICU住院时间。
items.titleZh: 综合呼吸与功能训练对急腹症术后脱离机械通气、呼吸和外周肌力、功能能力及疼痛的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验研究了综合呼吸和功能训练对急腹症术后患者脱离机械通气、呼吸和外周肌力、功能能力和疼痛的影响。该研究旨在解决这些患者常见的呼吸功能障碍和住院时间延长问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients recovering from emergency abdominal surgery, consider integrating respiratory and functional training into their rehab protocols. This RCT suggests that such an integrated approach may facilitate earlier weaning from mechanical ventilation, improve muscle strength and function, and potentially reduce pain, ultimately shortening ICU stays.
items.limitation: 摘要未给出具体的效应量和统计学结果，无法判断其临床显著性。
items.limitationEn: The abstract does not provide specific effect sizes or statistical results, making it impossible to determine clinical significance.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Bothersome and activity-limiting pain in community-dwelling older adults with versus without stroke: a cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends study (2011-2024).
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of 12,797 older adults (2011-2024 NHATS data) found that those with a history of stroke had a higher prevalence of bothersome pain (60.77% vs. 54.66%) and activity-limiting pain (62.83% vs. 52.00%). Stroke was independently associated with both outcomes (OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66 for bothersome pain; OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38 for activity-limiting pain) after adjustment.
items.curatedReason: 有卒中史的老年社区居民报告困扰性疼痛和活动受限性疼痛的比例显著高于无卒中史者，且这种关联独立于其他因素。这提醒你对卒中患者的疼痛评估和管理应作为康复的重要组成部分。
items.titleZh: 伴或不伴卒中史的社区居住老年人中困扰性与活动受限性疼痛：对国家健康与老龄化趋势研究（2011-2024）的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对12,797名老年人（2011-2024年NHATS数据）的横断面分析显示，有卒中史者报告困扰性疼痛（60.77% vs 54.66%）和活动受限性疼痛（62.83% vs 52.00%）的患病率更高。在调整其他因素后，卒中与这两种疼痛结局独立相关（困扰性疼痛OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66；活动受限性疼痛OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Community-dwelling older adults with a history of stroke report significantly higher rates of bothersome and activity-limiting pain, independent of other factors. This highlights the importance of comprehensive pain assessment and management as a crucial component of stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确立卒中与疼痛之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish a causal relationship between stroke and pain.

items.title: Maternal and fetal cardiovascular response to moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise in singleton and twin pregnancies
items.summary: This study investigated maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses to a submaximal graded cycling exercise test up to vigorous intensity in singleton and twin pregnancies. It found that the exercise was well tolerated by both mothers and fetuses, with few differences in responses between twin and singleton gestations.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了高质量证据，表明中等到剧烈强度运动对单胎和双胎妊娠的母胎心血管反应相似且耐受良好。这为你向双胎妊娠患者提供运动建议提供了更坚实的依据。
items.titleZh: 单胎和双胎妊娠中中度至剧烈强度运动对母胎心血管反应的影响
items.summaryZh: 本研究调查了中度至剧烈强度分级自行车运动对单胎和双胎妊娠母胎心血管反应的影响。结果显示，母亲和胎儿对运动的耐受性良好，双胎和单胎妊娠的反应差异很小。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides high-quality evidence that moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise elicits similar and well-tolerated maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses in both singleton and twin pregnancies. This gives you a more robust basis for advising pregnant patients with twins on exercise.
items.limitation: 这是一项对急性运动反应的评估，未涉及长期运动干预的效果和安全性。
items.limitationEn: This study assessed acute exercise responses and did not evaluate the long-term effects or safety of exercise interventions.

items.title: Return to sport after primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction in athletes with a preinjury Tegner Activity Scale >=7: a longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study
items.summary: A longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study of 511 female and male athletes with a pre-injury Tegner Activity Scale ≥7 found that 62% achieved return to sport (Tegner Activity Scale ≥7) within 24 months after primary ACL reconstruction, with an average duration of 12.3 months. However, only 51% returned to their pre-injury level.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对高水平运动员的全国性研究提供了ACL重建术后重返运动（RTS）的详细随访数据。尽管大多数运动员能在24个月内重返原高水平运动，但仍有近半数未能完全恢复到受伤前状态。这提示你管理患者期望并进行更精细的RTS评估至关重要。
items.titleZh: Tegner活动量表评分≥7的运动员初次前交叉韧带重建术后重返运动：一项基于全国注册的纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对511名术前Tegner活动量表评分≥7的男性和女性运动员进行的全国性、基于注册的纵向队列研究发现，62%的运动员在初次ACL重建术后24个月内重返运动（Tegner活动量表≥7），平均持续时间为12.3个月。然而，只有51%的参与者完全恢复到受伤前水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This nationwide study on high-level athletes provides detailed follow-up data on return to sport (RTS) after ACL reconstruction. While most athletes returned to their pre-injury level within 24 months, nearly half did not fully recover. This underscores the importance of managing patient expectations and conducting more refined RTS assessments.
items.limitation: 研究依赖于患者自报的Tegner活动量表评分，可能存在回忆偏差和主观性。
items.limitationEn: The study relied on patient-reported Tegner Activity Scale scores, which may introduce recall bias and subjectivity.

items.title: Examining the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of Para athletes in elite sport: a qualitative description study
items.summary: A qualitative descriptive study explored the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of elite Para athletes, revealing pervasive disability-specific knowledge gaps among coaches, healthcare providers, and sport organizations. Para athletes navigated equipment adaptations, health monitoring, and training modifications with insufficient support due to a lack of disability-informed expertise.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了残疾运动员在妊娠和产后阶段面临的独特挑战，包括教练和医疗服务提供者的知识空白以及政策支持的不足。这提示你，为残疾运动员提供支持需要更专业、更个体化的指导和资源。
items.titleZh: 精英运动中残疾运动员的妊娠和产后经历：一项定性描述研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性描述研究探讨了精英残疾运动员的妊娠和产后经历，揭示了教练、医疗服务提供者和体育组织中普遍存在的残疾特异性知识空白。残疾运动员在缺乏残疾知情专业知识的情况下，在器械调整、健康监测和训练修改方面获得了不足的支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the unique challenges faced by Para athletes during pregnancy and postpartum, including knowledge gaps among coaches and healthcare providers, and inadequate policy support. This suggests that supporting Para athletes requires more specialized and individualized guidance and resources.
items.limitation: 定性研究结果的普遍性可能受限，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: The generalizability of qualitative study findings may be limited, and the sample size was small.

items.title: Pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation: reporting quality, progression to trials, and barriers: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 28 pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation found that reporting quality averaged 6.1 out of 11 points, and only 12% (3 out of 26) progressed to a definitive randomized controlled trial. Lack of funding was the primary barrier for not proceeding to an RCT.
items.curatedReason: 卒中康复领域先导性和可行性研究的报告质量普遍不足，且仅有少数研究能最终进展为随机对照试验。这提示你在评估新干预措施时，对早期研究的结论应保持高度审慎。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复领域的先导性和可行性研究：报告质量、进展到试验情况及障碍：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对28项卒中康复先导性和可行性研究的范围综述发现，这些研究的报告质量平均为11分中的6.1分，且仅有12%（26项中的3项）最终进展为随机对照试验。缺乏资金是未能进一步开展RCT的主要原因。
items.curatedReasonEn: Reporting quality of pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation is generally suboptimal, with only a small fraction progressing to definitive RCTs. This indicates you should maintain high caution when evaluating conclusions from early-stage studies on new interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，评估的是研究报告质量而非干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, evaluating reporting quality rather than intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Georges Gymnastics Program: scaling an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability through an Olympic training centre partnership
items.summary: In Australia, approximately 1 in 20 children under 15 live with intellectual disability, facing higher risks of lifestyle-related health problems and barriers to sport participation.
items.curatedReason: Georges体操项目与奥运训练中心的合作，为智力障碍儿童提供了包容性的学校体操服务，展示了将专业运动资源应用于特殊儿童康复的有效模式。这提示你可以探索类似的跨界合作，以扩大康复服务的可及性和质量。
items.titleZh: Georges体操项目：通过与奥运训练中心合作，扩大为智力障碍儿童提供的包容性校本体操服务
items.summaryZh: Georges体操项目通过与奥运训练中心合作，成功地为智力障碍儿童提供了包容性的校本体操服务，旨在改善其身体活动和独立性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Georges Gymnastics Program's partnership with an Olympic training center offers inclusive school-based gymnastics for children with intellectual disabilities, showcasing an effective model for applying elite sports resources to special needs rehabilitation. This suggests you could explore similar cross-sector collaborations to expand the accessibility and quality of rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 这是一项描述项目开展的文章，而非对项目效果进行严格评估的研究。
items.limitationEn: This article describes a program implementation, not a rigorous evaluation of its effects.

items.title: Endometriosis and elite sports: a blind spot in research
items.summary: This commentary highlights that endometriosis, a chronic inflammatory disease affecting over 10% of women of reproductive age, remains a significant blind spot in sports research. Its symptoms, including severe dysmenorrhea, chronic pelvic pain, and fatigue, can profoundly impact elite female athletes' daily functioning, training capacity, recovery, and performance.
items.curatedReason: 子宫内膜异位症在运动研究中仍是一个“盲点”，其症状可能严重影响女性运动员的训练能力、恢复和表现。这提示你在评估和治疗女性运动员时，需警惕并关注此类慢性疾病的影响，并倡导更多相关研究。
items.titleZh: 子宫内膜异位症与精英运动：研究中的一个盲点
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评指出，子宫内膜异位症作为一种影响全球超过10%育龄女性的慢性炎症性疾病，在运动研究中仍是一个显著的盲点。其症状（包括严重痛经、慢性盆腔疼痛和疲劳）可能对精英女性运动员的日常功能、训练能力、恢复和表现产生深远影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Endometriosis remains a "blind spot" in sports research, yet its symptoms can severely impact female athletes' training capacity, recovery, and performance. This suggests you should be vigilant and attentive to the effects of such chronic conditions when evaluating and treating female athletes, and advocate for more related research.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评，旨在强调研究空白，未提供具体的研究数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary highlighting a research gap, not providing specific research data.

items.title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.summary: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) released a clinical practice guideline for hamstring strain injury rehabilitation, utilizing the GRADE approach to synthesize evidence from randomized clinical trials for clinicians and athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床实践指南（CPG）采用 GRADE 方法，为蕦绳肌拉伤的康复提供了基于 RCT 证据的最新建议。请根据指南调整您的临床决策，以优化运动员的蕦绳肌拉伤管理和重返运动策略。
items.titleZh: 运动员蕦绳肌拉伤的康复：SONAFE-巴西临床实践指南。
items.summaryZh: 巴西国家运动物理治疗学会（SONAFE-Brazil）发布了针对蕦绳肌拉伤康复的临床实践指南，采用 GRADE 方法综合了随机临床试验证据，为临床医生和运动员提供指导。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical practice guideline (CPG), developed using the GRADE approach, provides updated evidence-based recommendations from RCTs for hamstring strain injury rehabilitation. Adjust your clinical decisions based on these guidelines to optimize hamstring management and return-to-sport strategies for athletes.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Reframing hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a measurement instrument rather than a technique debate: a theoretical framework applying COSMIN to HODA-A.
items.summary: This theoretical paper proposes a Hands-On Data Acquisition and Analysis (HODA-A) framework, applying COSMIN principles to conceptualize hands-on musculoskeletal assessment as a clinician-reported outcome measurement process rather than isolated manual techniques.
items.curatedReason: 本框架将手法评估重新定义为临床报告结果测量（CROM），而非孤立手法技术。它为骨科/肌肉骨骼治疗师提供了一套严谨的评估路径，帮助您规范手法评估流程，提升其科学性和可信度。
items.titleZh: 将手法肌肉骨骼评估重新定义为测量工具而非技术辩论：一个应用 COSMIN 于 HODA-A 的理论框架。
items.summaryZh: 这篇理论文章提出了一个手法数据采集与分析（HODA-A）框架，将 COSMIN 原则应用于将手法肌肉骨骼评估概念化为临床报告的结果测量过程，而非孤立的手法技术。
items.curatedReasonEn: Hands-on assessment isn't just isolated techniques; it should be viewed as a clinician-reported outcome measure (CROM). This HODA-A framework, built on COSMIN principles, offers orthopedic/musculoskeletal therapists a rigorous pathway to conceptualize and standardize manual assessments, enhancing their scientific validity and credibility.
items.limitation: 这是一篇理论性框架文章，并非实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a theoretical framework paper, not an empirical study.

items.title: Effects of thoracic kinesiological taping on pulmonary functions, respiratory muscle strength, and functional independence in patients with hemiplegia: a randomized controlled clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=30) found that thoracic kinesiology taping combined with conventional rehabilitation significantly improved pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF) and maximal inspiratory pressure, as well as Functional Independence Measure scores, in individuals with chronic post-stroke hemiplegia.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性卒中偏瘫患者，胸部肌内效贴结合常规康复，可以显著改善肺功能（FVC、FEV1、PEF）和最大吸气压，同时提升功能独立性。在神经呼吸康复中，可考虑将其作为辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 胸部肌内效贴对偏瘫患者肺功能、呼吸肌强度和功能独立性的影响：一项随机对照临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=30）发现，胸部肌内效贴结合常规康复显著改善了慢性卒中偏瘫患者的肺功能（FVC, FEV1, PEF）、最大吸气压和功能独立性评分。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with chronic post-stroke hemiplegia, adding thoracic kinesiology taping to conventional rehabilitation significantly improves pulmonary function (FVC, FEV1, PEF) and maximal inspiratory pressure, along with Functional Independence Measure scores. You should consider this as an adjunct in neuro-respiratory rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究随访时间较短，仅限于慢性卒中患者，且对最大呼气压改善不显著。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up period of this study was short, limited to chronic stroke patients, and showed no significant improvement in maximal expiratory pressure.

items.title: Comparison of kinesio taping and myofascial release therapy in cervicogenic headache: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=81) found that both kinesio taping and myofascial release, combined with home exercise, effectively reduced pain and headache frequency in cervicogenic headache. MFR provided more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 肌内效贴（KT）和筋膜松弛术（MFR）结合家庭运动对颈源性头痛均有效，但 MFR 在改善残疾和身体生活质量方面可能提供更持久的疗效。在为颈源性头痛患者制定康复方案时，请优先考虑 MFR，以期获得更长期的获益。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴与筋膜松弛术治疗颈源性头痛的比较：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=81）发现，肌内效贴和筋膜松弛术结合家庭运动均能有效减轻颈源性头痛患者的疼痛和头痛频率。筋膜松弛术在改善残疾和身体生活质量方面提供了更持久的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Kinesio taping (KT) and myofascial release (MFR) combined with home exercise are both effective for cervicogenic headache, but MFR may offer more sustained improvements in disability and physical quality of life. Prioritize MFR in your rehabilitation plans for cervicogenic headache patients, aiming for longer-term benefits.
items.limitation: 本研究随访时间较短（1 个月），且未完全阐明两种干预机制差异。
items.limitationEn: This study had a short follow-up period (1 month) and did not fully elucidate the differences in mechanisms between the two interventions.

items.title: How does pre-stroke physical activity influence physical activity one year after minor stroke, and what role does cognitive impairment play?
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 100 minor stroke patients found that low pre-stroke physical activity was associated with higher odds of low physical activity 12 months post-stroke (OR=5.81, 95% CI: 1.61-24.0, p=0.010), suggesting its utility in identifying at-risk patients.
items.curatedReason: 卒中前活动量低的患者，卒中后 12 个月内持续不活跃的风险高（OR=5.81）。您在评估轻度卒中患者时，应将卒中前活动水平作为预测指标，用于识别高风险患者并尽早规划个性化康复干预。
items.titleZh: 卒中前体力活动如何影响轻度卒中后一年体力活动，以及认知障碍扮演的角色？
items.summaryZh: 对 100 名轻度卒中患者的二次分析发现，卒中前体力活动量低与卒中后 12 个月体力活动量低相关性较高（OR=5.81, 95% CI: 1.61-24.0, p=0.010），这表明其有助于识别高风险患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with low pre-stroke physical activity have higher odds (OR=5.81) of persistent inactivity 12 months post-stroke. When assessing patients with minor stroke, use pre-stroke activity levels as a predictor to identify high-risk individuals and initiate personalized rehabilitation early.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列分析，样本量较小（n=100），且认知障碍的调节作用尚无定论。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort analysis with a small sample size (n=100), and the modifying role of cognitive impairment remains inconclusive.

items.title: Design of an Early Exercise Program for Hospitalized Patients: "Let's Move".
items.summary: The "Let's Move" program, an implementation-oriented early exercise initiative, was developed and piloted in a tertiary hospital, showing high adherence (76.5%) and no adverse events, supporting its feasibility and safety in promoting mobility for hospitalized adults.
items.curatedReason: “Let's Move”是一个针对住院患者的早期运动计划，旨在减少医院相关失能。该项目通过整合简短的患者教育和低强度运动，提供了一种实用的工作流程，有助于您在临床中更有效地推行早期活动。
items.titleZh: 住院患者早期运动计划“Let's Move”的设计。
items.summaryZh: “Let's Move”计划是一项以实施为导向的早期运动倡议，在一个三级医院进行了开发和试点，显示出高依从性（76.5%）且未发生不良事件，支持了其在促进住院成年人活动方面的可行性和安全性。
items.curatedReasonEn: “Let's Move” is an early exercise program for hospitalized patients, aimed at reducing hospital-associated deconditioning. This program integrates brief patient education with low-intensity exercise, offering a practical workflow to help you more effectively implement early mobility in clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为初步实施和概念验证，样本量小，且主要关注可行性和安全性。
items.limitationEn: This study is a preliminary implementation and proof-of-concept, with a small sample size, primarily focusing on feasibility and safety.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD
items.summary: This study aims to evaluate the technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for COPD patients, including data transmission from connected devices and a home-based PR program, and explore clinical outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，将互联设备数据传输与居家肺康复（PR）相结合的远程康复模式，在 COPD 患者中具有技术和临床可行性。远程医疗是大势所趋，这一模式可能为患者提供更便捷的康复途径。
items.titleZh: COPD 患者肺部远程康复模型的技术和临床可行性。
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在评估 COPD 患者肺部远程康复模型的技术和临床可行性，包括连接设备的数据传输和居家肺部康复计划，并探索临床结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that a pulmonary telerehabilitation model, combining connected device data transmission with home-based PR, is technically and clinically feasible for COPD patients. As telehealth expands, this model could offer a more accessible rehabilitation pathway for your patients.
items.limitation: 本研究主要关注技术和临床可行性，对具体临床结局的评估为探索性。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily focuses on technical and clinical feasibility, with an exploratory assessment of specific clinical outcomes.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Optimal Dextrose Concentration for Prolotherapy in TendinopathyA Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis aims to compare the effectiveness of different dextrose concentrations used in prolotherapy for reducing pain in patients with tendinopathy.
items.curatedReason: 在肌腱病增生疗法中，选择不同浓度的葡萄糖可能影响止痛效果。这项系统综述和网络 Meta 分析将明确何种葡萄糖浓度最有效，你应关注其结果，以优化临床实践中的注射方案。
items.titleZh: 肌腱病增生疗法中葡萄糖最佳浓度：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和网络 Meta 分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和网络 Meta 分析旨在比较不同葡萄糖浓度增生疗法在减轻肌腱病患者疼痛方面的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Different dextrose concentrations in prolotherapy for tendinopathy may yield varying pain reduction. This systematic review and network meta-analysis will clarify which concentrations are most effective; pay close attention to its findings to optimize your injection protocols.
items.limitation: 网络 Meta 分析可能存在间接比较的局限性，且可能受纳入研究异质性的影响。
items.limitationEn: Network meta-analysis may have limitations of indirect comparisons and may be affected by heterogeneity of included studies.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Enhancing mountain safety through personalised exercise prescription: the MOVE project (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: The MOVE project developed a personalized digital decision-support system to enhance mountain hiking safety by integrating individual health characteristics with trail-specific demands, providing individualized hiking time estimates and tailored exercise recommendations.
items.curatedReason: MOVE 项目是一个为登山者提供个性化运动处方的工具，通过整合健康特征和路径需求来提升山区运动安全性。这提示我们，个性化、数据驱动的运动处方对于降低运动损伤和急性疾病的风险至关重要，尤其是在户外运动领域。
items.titleZh: 通过个性化运动处方提高山区安全性：MOVE 项目（博士学院奖）。
items.summaryZh: MOVE 项目开发了一个个性化数字决策支持系统，通过整合个人健康特征与路径特定需求来提高山区徒步的安全性，提供个性化的徒步时间估算和量身定制的运动建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: The MOVE project, a personalized exercise prescription tool for hikers, enhances mountain safety by integrating individual health characteristics with trail demands. This highlights the critical role of personalized, data-driven exercise prescriptions in reducing the risk of injuries and acute illnesses, especially in outdoor sports.
items.limitation: 这是一项博士研究成果的摘要，具体数据和方法细节需查阅完整论文。
items.limitationEn: This is an abstract of a PhD research outcome; full data and methodological details require reviewing the complete thesis.

items.title: Do Classical Speed-Accuracy Trade-Off Models Generalize to Lower Limb Movements?
items.summary: This study investigates the generalizability of classical speed-accuracy trade-off models to lower limb movements during targeted stepping, examining how instructional emphasis and spatial demands modulate strategy and pre-step postural dynamics in 24 healthy young adults.
items.curatedReason: 经典的速度-准确性权衡模型能否推广到下肢靶向踏步运动中？本研究观察了 24 名健康年轻人，发现指令重点和空间需求会影响策略和步前姿势动力学。这提示 Fitts 定律在步态和平衡训练中的适用性可能存在边界，并非一概而论。
items.titleZh: 经典速度-准确性权衡模型是否适用于下肢运动？
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在探讨经典速度-准确性权衡模型对目标性步进下肢运动的普适性，考察指令强调和空间需求如何调节 24 名健康年轻成年人的策略和预步姿势动力学。
items.curatedReasonEn: Can classical speed-accuracy trade-off models generalize to lower limb targeted stepping? This study, observing 24 healthy young adults, suggests that instructional emphasis and spatial demands modulate strategy and pre-step postural dynamics. This implies that Fitts' Law's applicability in gait and balance training might have boundaries, rather than being universally applicable.
items.limitation: 本研究是一项方案描述，尚未得出最终结果。
items.limitationEn: This study is a protocol description and has not yet yielded final results.

items.title: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 37 studies found very low certainty evidence regarding whether reduced spinal range of motion is a prognostic factor for pain, disability, or recovery in spinal pain patients, with inconsistent results and all studies rated as high risk of bias.
items.curatedReason: 别再纠结脊柱活动度下降是不是疼痛、残疾或恢复的预测因素了，证据质量差，研究结果也乱七八糟，无法下定论。
items.titleZh: 脊柱活动度降低是否是特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和总体恢复的预后因素？一项系统评价
items.titleEn: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 37 项研究的系统评价发现，关于脊柱活动度降低是否是脊柱疼痛患者疼痛、残疾或恢复的预后因素，证据确定性非常低，且结果不一致，所有研究均被评为高偏倚风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review concluded that the evidence is very low certainty and it's unclear if reduced spinal range of motion independently predicts pain, disability, or recovery in spinal pain patients due to inconsistent findings across numerous studies, all rated as high risk of bias.
items.limitation: All 37 included studies were rated as high risk of bias, and findings were inconsistent across conditions and follow-ups.
items.limitationEn: All 37 included studies were rated as high risk of bias, and findings were inconsistent across conditions and follow-ups.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Effect of iTBS and rTMS Combined with Robotic Rehabilitation on Ambulation and Lower Extremity Motor Function in Chronic SCI Patients.
items.summary: An RCT found that intermittent theta-burst stimulation (iTBS) and repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with robotic rehabilitation improved ambulation and lower extremity motor function in chronic spinal cord injury patients compared to sham, with no significant differences between active protocols.
items.curatedReason: iTBS 和 rTMS 联合机器人辅助康复都有效，但两者之间无显著差异，别纠结选哪个。
items.titleZh: 间歇性 theta 脉冲刺激 (iTBS) 和重复经颅磁刺激 (rTMS) 联合机器人康复对慢性脊髓损伤患者行走能力和下肢运动功能的影响
items.titleEn: Effect of iTBS and rTMS Combined with Robotic Rehabilitation on Ambulation and Lower Extremity Motor Function in Chronic SCI Patients.
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，与假刺激相比，间歇性 theta 脉冲刺激 (iTBS) 和重复经颅磁刺激 (rTMS) 联合机器人康复可改善慢性脊髓损伤患者的行走能力和下肢运动功能，但两种活性方案之间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that both iTBS and rTMS combined with robotic rehabilitation improved ambulation and lower extremity motor function in chronic SCI patients compared to sham, though no significant differences were observed between the two active protocols.
items.limitation: The study was conducted at a single center and had a small sample size (n=30).
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted at a single center and had a small sample size (n=30).
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review concluded that shear wave elastography can detect muscle-specific stiffness deficits after ACL reconstruction, including reduced vastus medialis and semitendinosus stiffness, which correlate with function beyond strength, but standardized protocols are required for clinical guidance.
items.curatedReason: 剪切波弹性成像可识别 ACL 术后肌肉僵硬（如股内侧肌、腘绳肌），并与功能相关，但需标准化方案方可临床应用。
items.titleZh: 剪切波弹性成像用于评估前交叉韧带重建术后下肢肌肉僵硬度：一项系统评价
items.titleEn: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summaryZh: 一项系统评价得出结论，剪切波弹性成像可检测 ACL 重建术后肌肉特异性僵硬度缺陷，包括股内侧肌和腘绳肌肌腱僵硬度降低，这与超越力量的功能相关，但临床应用需要标准化方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review found that shear wave elastography can detect muscle-specific mechanical deficits after ACL reconstruction, such as reduced vastus medialis stiffness and semitendinosus stiffness, which relate to function beyond strength, but standardized protocols are needed for clinical application.
items.limitation: No studies sampled the distal vastus medialis obliquus or the distal hamstring musculotendinous region, and standardized protocols are needed for clinical use.
items.limitationEn: No studies sampled the distal vastus medialis obliquus or the distal hamstring musculotendinous region, and standardized protocols are needed for clinical use.

items.title: Dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 studies found very low certainty evidence that dextrose prolotherapy offers little to no benefit for chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy/bursitis compared to saline, and may result in worse physical performance compared to corticosteroid injections.
items.curatedReason: 证据级别很低，别再用右旋糖酐做肩袖肌腱病/滑囊炎了，相比生理盐水效果差不多，甚至可能不如皮质类固醇。需要高质量RCT。
items.titleZh: 慢性症状性肩袖肌腱病和肩峰下滑囊炎的葡萄糖胺增生疗法：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.titleEn: Dextrose prolotherapy for chronic symptomatic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summaryZh: 一项涉及 14 项研究的系统评价和荟萃分析发现，对于慢性肩袖肌腱病/肩峰下滑囊炎，葡萄糖胺增生疗法与生理盐水相比，获益非常不确定，且与皮质类固醇注射相比，可能导致体能表现下降，证据确定性非常低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis found very low certainty evidence for dextrose prolotherapy in chronic rotator cuff tendinopathy and subacromial bursitis. Compared to saline, it may offer little to no benefit, and compared to corticosteroid injections, it may lead to worse physical performance. High-quality RCTs are needed.
items.limitation: Most included studies had a high risk of bias, and sample sizes were mostly small.

items.title: Patients' experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study.

items.titleZh: 产后盆底功能障碍患者接受物理治疗远程康复的体验：一项定性研究
items.titleEn: Patients' experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study.
items.summaryZh: 一项探讨产后盆底功能障碍患者接受物理治疗远程康复体验的定性研究发现，患者认为远程康复是实体就诊的补充工具，可提高可及性和灵活性，但也突出了对高级数字沟通技能的需求及对缺乏体格检查的担忧。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights that patients perceive telerehabilitation as a valuable complement to in-person visits for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction, improving accessibility and flexibility. items.title: The enhanced rehabilitation programme for significant musculoskeletal injuries from the manchester arena bombing - A process evaluation study investigating patients' and physiotherapists' experiences.
items.summary: A process evaluation of an enhanced rehabilitation program for major trauma survivors found it beneficial for recovery and motivation but identified challenges in sustaining progress and transitioning to standard care, indicating a need for improved long-term rehabilitation pathways.

items.titleZh: 重大肌肉骨骼损伤强化康复计划的疗程评估：调查患者和物理治疗师经验
items.titleEn: The enhanced rehabilitation programme for significant musculoskeletal injuries from the manchester arena bombing - A process evaluation study investigating patients' and physiotherapists' experiences.
items.summaryZh: 一项对重大创伤幸存者强化康复计划的疗程评估发现，该计划对身心恢复和动机有益，但识别出在维持进展和过渡到标准护理方面存在挑战，表明需要改善长期康复路径。
items.curatedReasonEn: A process evaluation of an enhanced rehabilitation program for major trauma survivors found it valuable for physical and psychological recovery but noted challenges with sustaining progress and transitioning back to standard NHS care, highlighting the need for long-term pathways.

items.limitationEn: The study focused on patient and physiotherapist experiences within a specific program and did not evaluate long-term clinical outcomes.

items.title: First aggression as a planning signal in post-acute stroke rehabilitation: Service benchmarks, goal setting, and a 60-day precaution window from a comprehensive observational cohort.
items.summary: An observational study in post-acute stroke rehabilitation established service benchmarks following the first aggression event, indicating a 60-day precaution window and functional gaps to inform goal setting and discharge planning, though multicenter validation is needed.
items.curatedReason: 中风后出现攻击行为，60天内都得留神，这项基准数据能帮你评估功能缺口，设定靠谱的目标和出院计划。
items.titleZh: 攻击行为作为急性后卒中康复的规划信号：基于综合观察队列的服务基准、目标设定和 60 天预防窗口
items.titleEn: First aggression as a planning signal in post-acute stroke rehabilitation: Service benchmarks, goal setting, and a 60-day precaution window from a comprehensive observational cohort.
items.summaryZh: 一项关于急性后卒中康复的观察性研究，在首次记录的攻击行为后建立了服务基准，提示了 60 天的预防窗口和功能差距，可用于指导目标设定和出院规划，但需要多中心验证。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study proposes service benchmarks based on the first documented aggression event in post-acute stroke rehabilitation, suggesting a 60-day precaution window and providing data on functional gaps to guide realistic goal setting and discharge planning.

items.limitationEn: The study was conducted at a single tertiary neurorehabilitation hospital and requires multicenter validation.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Association between hospital-level factors and early rehabilitation initiation in patients with acute ischemic stroke: a multilevel analysis using a Japanese administrative database from a rural prefecture.
items.summary: A multilevel analysis of Japanese administrative data revealed that hospital-level provision of weekend rehabilitation services was significantly associated with earlier initiation of rehabilitation for acute ischemic stroke patients.
items.curatedReason: 急性缺血性中风患者，若医院提供周末康复，你得留意其患者开始康复的时间可能更早。这提示了组织层面的服务安排，可能比你想象的对早期康复启动更重要。
items.titleZh: 医院层面因素与急性缺血性卒中患者早期康复启动的关联：基于日本农村地区行政数据库的多层分析
items.titleEn: Association between hospital-level factors and early rehabilitation initiation in patients with acute ischemic stroke: a multilevel analysis using a Japanese administrative database from a rural prefecture.
items.summaryZh: 一项对日本行政数据进行的多层分析显示，医院提供周末康复服务与急性缺血性卒中患者早期康复启动显著相关，表明组织系统在早期康复启动差异中起关键作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: For acute ischemic stroke patients, be aware that those treated at hospitals offering weekend rehabilitation may initiate therapy earlier. This highlights the potential impact of organizational service scheduling on early rehabilitation initiation, suggesting it's a more significant factor than previously assumed.
items.limitation: The study used data from a single prefecture in Japan and did not analyze therapist staffing levels or annual stroke volume.
items.limitationEn: The study used data from a single prefecture in Japan and did not analyze therapist staffing levels or annual stroke volume.

items.title: An exploration of self-evaluation of induced temporal and spatial gait asymmetry in neurotypical young adults.
items.summary: This study found that neurotypical adults are more accurate in self-evaluating temporal gait asymmetry than spatial asymmetry, and focusing attention on the swing phase may enhance temporal self-evaluation, offering insights for post-stroke gait rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 健康成人能更准确地自我评估时间性步态不对称，将注意力集中在摆动期可能提升自我评估效果，对中风后步态康复有借鉴意义。
items.titleZh: 对神经典型年轻成人诱发的时间性和空间性步态不对称性的自我评估的探索
items.titleEn: An exploration of self-evaluation of induced temporal and spatial gait asymmetry in neurotypical young adults.
items.summaryZh: 本研究发现，神经典型成人对时间性步态不对称性的自我评估比空间性步态不对称性更准确，并且将注意力引导至摆动相可能提高时间性自我评估的准确性，这为卒中后步态不对称性康复提供了背景信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that neurotypical adults are more accurate at self-evaluating temporal gait asymmetry than spatial asymmetry, and directing attention to the swing phase may improve temporal self-evaluation, providing context for post-stroke gait rehabilitation.
items.limitation: The study involved only neurotypical young adults and did not include individuals with stroke.
items.limitationEn: The study involved only neurotypical young adults and did not include individuals with stroke.

items.title: Quantifying Static Postural Control Impairment after Stroke using Markerless Motion Capture
items.summary: Markerless motion capture effectively quantifies static postural control impairment in individuals with stroke, with parameters showing strong correlations to clinical balance measures, indicating its potential for clinical assessment.
items.curatedReason: 研究证实，无标记运动捕捉技术能有效量化卒中患者的静态姿势控制障碍，其参数与临床平衡评估结果高度相关，可用于临床评估。
items.titleZh: 使用无标记动作捕捉量化卒中后静态姿势控制障碍
items.titleEn: Quantifying Static Postural Control Impairment after Stroke using Markerless Motion Capture
items.summaryZh: 这项研究表明，无标记动作捕捉技术能够有效量化卒中患者的静态姿势控制障碍，其参数与临床平衡评估指标显示出很强的相关性，预示其在临床评估中的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates the utility of markerless motion capture for quantifying static postural control impairment in individuals with stroke, showing significant correlations between motion capture parameters and clinical balance scores.
items.limitation: This study focused on static postural control and requires further research to evaluate dynamic tasks and gait.
items.limitationEn: This study focused on static postural control and requires further research to evaluate dynamic tasks and gait.

items.title: Not Just Faster Horses: Telerehabilitation as a Necessary Evolution in Physical Therapy.
items.summary: This editorial posits that telerehabilitation represents a necessary evolution for musculoskeletal physical therapy, extending clinicians' roles rather than replacing them, and calls for adapting professional habits and integrating digital tools to preserve therapeutic relationships.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复是物理治疗的进化，不是替代，它扩展了治疗师的角色，但你得学会新工具和新打法。
items.titleZh: 不只是更快的马：远程康复作为物理治疗的必要演变
items.titleEn: Not Just Faster Horses: Telerehabilitation as a Necessary Evolution in Physical Therapy.
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论认为，远程康复是肌肉骨骼物理治疗的必要演变，而非替代方案，它通过加强监测和患者参与来扩展治疗师的作用，需要新的技能和职业习惯的适应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial argues that telerehabilitation should be viewed not as an alternative but as an evolution for musculoskeletal physical therapy, extending the therapist's role through enhanced monitoring and engagement, necessitating new skills and adapted habits.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study.
items.summary: A longitudinal study of traumatic spinal cord injury patients indicated that lower and declining social integration were associated with increased all-cause and cause-specific mortality, though causality could not be established due to study limitations.
items.curatedReason: 脊髓损伤后，社交越孤立、越退步，死亡风险越高，但这只是相关性，别当因果关系去治。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后随时间变化的社会融合与全因及特定原因死亡率：一项纵向 SCIMS 研究
items.titleEn: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study.
items.summaryZh: 一项针对创伤性脊髓损伤患者的纵向研究表明，社会融合度降低和下降与全因及特定原因死亡率增加相关，但研究局限性（如幸存者选择、遗漏死因和残余混杂）限制了因果关系的确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This longitudinal study suggests that lower and declining social integration are associated with increased mortality after traumatic spinal cord injury. However, it notes that these findings do not establish a causal link and are limited by survivor selection and residual confounding.
items.limitation: The study cannot establish causality, and limitations include survivor selection, missing causes of death, and residual confounding.
items.limitationEn: The study cannot establish causality, and limitations include survivor selection, missing causes of death, and residual confounding.

items.title: Engagement strategies to support sub-acute, post-stroke upper limb interventions: A co-design study.
items.summary: A co-design study generated clinician-delivered strategies to enhance stroke survivor engagement in sub-acute upper limb rehabilitation, focusing on personalization via timing and emphasis, with clinical feasibility awaiting further testing.

items.titleZh: 促进亚急性期卒中上肢干预的参与策略：一项共同设计研究
items.titleEn: Engagement strategies to support sub-acute, post-stroke upper limb interventions: A co-design study.
items.summaryZh: 一项共同设计研究开发了由临床医生实施的策略，以促进卒中幸存者参与亚急性期上肢康复，强调通过时机和强调程度实现个性化，但临床可行性有待测试。
items.curatedReasonEn: This co-design study developed clinician-delivered strategies to support stroke survivor engagement in sub-acute upper limb rehabilitation, emphasizing personalization through timing and emphasis, though clinical feasibility needs testing.

items.limitationEn: The feasibility of these strategies in clinical practice remains to be tested.

items.title: Diagnostic Performance of Ultrasonographic Median Nerve Cross-Sectional Area for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome in Wheelchair Users With Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summary: Ultrasonographic median nerve cross-sectional area demonstrated moderate diagnostic accuracy for carpal tunnel syndrome in wheelchair users with spinal cord injury, with lower cutoffs enhancing sensitivity and higher cutoffs improving specificity.
items.curatedReason: 对轮椅使用者中的脊髓损伤患者，超声测正中神经截面积对腕管综合征的诊断准确度一般，但结合敏感度和特异度的要求，可以调整界值。
items.titleZh: 超声检查尺神经横截面积对脊髓损伤轮椅使用者的腕管综合征的诊断效能
items.titleEn: Diagnostic Performance of Ultrasonographic Median Nerve Cross-Sectional Area for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome in Wheelchair Users With Spinal Cord Injury.
items.summaryZh: 超声检查尺神经横截面积对于诊断脊髓损伤轮椅使用者的腕管综合征具有中度诊断准确性，较低的截断值可提高敏感性，较高的截断值可提高特异性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This diagnostic accuracy study found that ultrasonographic median nerve cross-sectional area has moderate accuracy for diagnosing carpal tunnel syndrome in wheelchair users with spinal cord injury, suggesting lower cutoffs favor sensitivity and higher cutoffs favor specificity.

items.limitationEn: The study included a relatively small sample size (67 participants) and was conducted at a single tertiary hospital.

items.title: Methodological quality of systematic reviews on treatments in stroke rehabilitation: A cross-sectional study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study assessing systematic reviews on stroke rehabilitation treatments found that 92.9% were of critically low methodological quality, highlighting significant deficiencies in review conduct and reporting.
items.curatedReason: 你正在评估的中风康复系统评价，有高达 92.9% 的方法学质量堪忧，这说明你依赖的文献证据本身可能就很不可靠，需要谨慎解读。

items.titleEn: Methodological quality of systematic reviews on treatments in stroke rehabilitation: A cross-sectional study.
items.summaryZh: 一项针对卒中康复治疗系统评价的研究发现，92.9% 的评价方法学质量极低，表明在评价的执行和报告方面存在显著缺陷。
items.curatedReasonEn: You should be cautious interpreting stroke rehabilitation systematic reviews, as up to 92.9% demonstrate critically low methodological quality, implying the evidence base you rely on may be fundamentally unsound.
items.limitation: A large majority (92.9%) of the reviewed systematic reviews were of critically low methodological quality.
items.limitationEn: A large majority (92.9%) of the reviewed systematic reviews were of critically low methodological quality.

items.title: "It's a black box": Physiotherapists' perspectives on sensorimotor control and the use of technology in this context to improve rehabilitation following ACL injury.
items.summary: Physiotherapists experienced in ACL rehabilitation are interested in using technology for sensorimotor assessment and training, but implementation is limited by uncertainty about clinical value and the need for clear benefits and integration into clinical reasoning.

items.titleZh: 关于运动传感器控制以及在此背景下利用技术改善前交叉韧带损伤后康复的物理治疗师的观点

items.curatedReasonEn: Physiotherapists view technology as potentially supportive for sensorimotor assessment and rehabilitation after ACL injury, but its clinical value and integration depend on demonstrating clear benefits, aligning with clinical reasoning, and adapting to new rehabilitation structures.

items.title: Return to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery: a survey of German surgeons and postoperative patient experiences.

items.curatedReason: 腰椎间盘术后重返运动的建议不统一，患者恢复时间普遍长于医生建议，亟需基于证据的指南。
items.titleZh: 腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动：德国外科医生和术后患者经验的调查
items.titleEn: Return to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery: a survey of German surgeons and postoperative patient experiences.
items.summaryZh: 对德国外科医生的一项调查显示，腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动的建议存在显著差异，患者报告的重返运动时间似乎晚于建议，这凸显了循证指南的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey of German surgeons revealed considerable variability in recommendations for return to sport after lumbar disc surgery, with patients' reported resumption of sports occurring later than recommended, highlighting the need for evidence-based guidelines.
items.limitation: The study's two datasets (surgeon recommendations and patient experiences) were from different designs and settings, limiting direct comparison.
items.limitationEn: The study's two datasets (surgeon recommendations and patient experiences) were from different designs and settings, limiting direct comparison.

items.title: Effect of Short-Rest Interval versus Traditional Multiple-Set Resistance Training Combined with Endurance Training in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: An RCT comparing short-rest interval (3/7) and traditional multiple-set (3x9) resistance training in cardiac rehabilitation found both effective for improving VO2peak, strength, and lean mass, with 3/7 RT showing greater improvement in isokinetic quadriceps strength.
items.curatedReason: 心脏康复中，短间歇（3/7）和传统多组（3x9）抗阻训练均可改善 VO2peak、力量和瘦体重，前者在股四头肌等速力量上优势更明显。
items.titleZh: 短间歇阻力训练与传统多组阻力训练结合耐力训练对心血管疾病患者的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.titleEn: Effect of Short-Rest Interval versus Traditional Multiple-Set Resistance Training Combined with Endurance Training in Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summaryZh: 一项随机临床试验比较了心脏康复项目中短间歇（3/7）阻力训练与传统多组（3×9）阻力训练结合耐力训练的效果，两者均改善了摄氧量峰值、力量和瘦体重，其中短间歇组在等速股四头肌力量上改善更显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that both short-rest interval (3/7) and traditional multiple-set (3x9) resistance training, when combined with endurance training in cardiac rehabilitation, improved VO2peak, strength, and lean mass, with short-rest intervals showing a greater improvement in isokinetic quadriceps strength.
items.limitation: While both protocols were effective, superiority was not consistently observed across all strength measures, and patient preference should be considered.

items.title: Experiences of sexual rehabilitation post-stroke among LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and their partners: a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the sexual rehabilitation experiences of LGBTQI+ stroke survivors (n=18) and their partners (n=5), revealing themes of sexuality being addressed or absent post-stroke, and negative interactions with health professionals. The findings suggest limited resources and a need for inclusive communication and training.
items.curatedReason: 本定性研究首次揭示 LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其伴侣在性康复方面的独特经历和障碍，提示你和你的团队应采用更具包容性的沟通方式，并探索额外的培训，以更好地满足这类患者的需求。
items.titleZh: LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者及其伴侣在卒中后性康复方面的经历：一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 LGBTQI+ 卒中幸存者（18 例）及其伴侣（5 例）在卒中后性康复方面的经历，揭示了性话题在康复中被提及或缺失，以及与医疗专业人员的负面互动等主题。研究提示资源有限，且需要更具包容性的沟通和培训。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study is the first to shed light on the unique experiences and barriers LGBTQI+ stroke survivors and their partners face in sexual rehabilitation. It prompts you and your team to adopt more inclusive communication and explore additional training to better meet the needs of this patient population.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（18 名卒中幸存者，5 名伴侣），发现仅为特定人群的经验，结论外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (18 stroke survivors, 5 partners), providing insights only into specific experiences, thus limiting the generalizability of its conclusions.

items.title: Burden of fall-related injury and its predictors among stroke survivors attending comprehensive specialized hospitals in the Amhara Regional State, Ethiopia, 2024: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter cross-sectional study among 269 stroke survivors in Ethiopia found a high prevalence of fall-related injury (79.9%, 95% CI: 75.1-84.4). Age > 65 (AOR=2.670), rural residence (AOR=2.352), and injury during walking and turning (AOR=2.960) were significant predictors.
items.curatedReason: 这项多中心研究揭示了埃塞俄比亚卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤的高负担，特别强调年龄、居住地和特定活动是预测因素，提醒你评估这些高风险因素以进行更有效的跌倒预防。
items.titleZh: 埃塞俄比亚阿姆哈拉州卒中幸存者跌倒相关损伤负担及其预测因素：一项多中心前瞻性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项对埃塞俄比亚 269 名卒中幸存者进行的多中心横断面研究发现，跌倒相关损伤的发生率高达 79.9%（95% CI: 75.1-84.4）。年龄 > 65 岁（AOR=2.670）、农村居住（AOR=2.352）以及在步行和转弯时受伤（AOR=2.960）是重要的预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter study reveals a high burden of fall-related injuries among stroke survivors in Ethiopia, highlighting age, rural residence, and specific activities as predictors. This reminds you to assess these high-risk factors for more effective fall prevention.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，只能识别相关因素，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study uses a cross-sectional design, identifying associations but not establishing causality.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 older adults post-total knee arthroplasty identified barriers (pain-triggered avoidance, fear, inadequate guidance, limited family support) and facilitators (perceived threat of poor prognosis, willpower, negotiation strategies) for home-based rehabilitation exercise decision-making. Findings suggest mitigating impulsive barriers and enhancing reflective engagement.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究提示，老年全膝关节置换术后居家康复依从性不佳，部分是疼痛引发的本能回避和恐惧所致。你应在提供全面疼痛管理的同时，加强安全有效的关节活动度指导，以减少冲动性障碍，并通过个性化目标设定和积极的文化框架来增强患者的理性参与。
items.titleZh: 老年全膝关节置换术后居家康复锻炼决策的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 21 名老年全膝关节置换术后患者的定性研究，识别出居家康复锻炼决策的障碍（疼痛引发的规避、恐惧、指导不足、家庭支持有限）和促进因素（对不良预后的感知威胁、意志力、协商策略）。研究结果提示应减轻冲动性障碍并增强反射性参与。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study suggests that poor adherence to home-based rehab post-TKA in older adults is partly driven by pain-triggered avoidance and fear. You should address these impulsive barriers with comprehensive pain management and clear guidance on safe, effective ROM, while fostering reflective engagement through personalized goal-setting and a positive cultural framework.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量较小（21 名老年患者），主要聚焦于中国三家三级医院的患者经历，研究发现的普遍性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (21 older adults) and focuses primarily on patient experiences from three tertiary hospitals in China, potentially limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Recent highlights in pulmonary rehabilitation research.
items.summary: A narrative review of pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) research (2021-2026) highlights its expanded scope beyond stable COPD to various chronic respiratory diseases, with evidence for alternative PR models and economic benefits. Challenges remain in access and maintaining benefits post-PR.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述总结了 2021-2026 年肺康复研究的进展，坐实了肺康复的适用范围已远超稳定期 COPD，且新型递送模式具备经济效益。它提示你拓宽肺康复服务的适应症范围，并考虑多样化的递送模式以提高可及性。
items.titleZh: 肺康复研究的最新亮点。
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于肺康复（PR）研究（2021-2026 年）的叙述性综述，强调其适用范围已从稳定期 COPD 扩展到多种慢性呼吸系统疾病，并有证据支持替代性 PR 模式和经济效益。但在提高可及性和维持 PR 后效益方面仍存在挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review summarizes pulmonary rehabilitation research from 2021-2026, confirming that PR's applicability extends far beyond stable COPD and that new delivery models are cost-effective. It prompts you to broaden the indications for PR services and consider diverse delivery models to improve accessibility.
items.limitation: 本综述为叙述性综述，未进行系统性的文献质量评估和定量合成，可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, lacking systematic quality assessment and quantitative synthesis, and may be subject to selection bias.

items.title: Blood flow restriction with different loads versus moderate intensity resistive exercises in patients with knee osteoarthritis: a single-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A single-blind RCT (n=75) on knee osteoarthritis patients compared passive blood flow restriction (BFR) at 50% and 70% limb occlusion pressure (LOP) with moderate-intensity resistance training (MI-RT). MI-RT yielded greater quadriceps strength. BFR-70% LOP significantly improved lower-extremity functional ability with less perceived exertion, while BFR-50% LOP showed smaller improvements.
items.curatedReason: 如果膝关节骨关节炎患者无法耐受常规中等强度阻力训练，那么 70% 肢体血流阻断压下的被动血流限制训练值得考虑。这项 RCT 表明，它能有效改善下肢功能，且患者感知劳累程度较低，优于 50% LOP，但对股四头肌力量的提升不如中等强度阻力训练。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者的血流限制联合不同负荷与中等强度阻力训练的比较：一项单盲随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对膝骨关节炎患者的单盲随机对照试验（75 例），比较了 50% 和 70% 肢体血流阻断压（LOP）下的被动血流限制（BFR）与中等强度阻力训练（MI-RT）。MI-RT 产生了更大的股四头肌力量增益。70% LOP 的 BFR 显著改善了下肢功能能力，且感知劳累较低，而 50% LOP 的 BFR 改善较小。
items.curatedReasonEn: Consider passive blood flow restriction at 70% limb occlusion pressure for knee OA patients who cannot tolerate conventional moderate-intensity resistance training. This RCT shows it significantly improves lower-extremity function with less perceived exertion, outperforming 50% LOP, though it yields less quadriceps strength gain than MI-RT.
items.limitation: 本研究为单盲设计，无法排除研究者偏倚对结果的影响，且未提供长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: This study is single-blinded, so researcher bias cannot be excluded, and long-term follow-up data are not provided.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy—a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study (n=15,197) of knee/hip osteoarthritis patients receiving digital education and exercise therapy found the proportion meeting recommended physical activity (PA) levels increased from 51.4% to 58.5% at one year. Four PA trajectories were identified (persistently high 41.2%, persistently low 30.4%, increasing 16.5%, declining 11.9%), with BMI and physical function being key associated factors. All trajectories showed comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项大样本纵向研究显示，数字化教育与运动疗法能有效提升膝/髋骨关节炎患者的体力活动水平，近六成患者达到或维持了推荐的活动量。这提示你，即使患者基线体力活动水平不高，这种干预模式也值得推荐，尤其要关注 BMI 较高和功能较差的患者。
items.titleZh: 数字化教育和运动疗法后体力活动轨迹：一项针对 15,197 名膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 15,197 名膝/髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究发现，接受数字化教育和运动疗法后，达到推荐体力活动（PA）水平的患者比例在一年内从 51.4% 增至 58.5%。研究识别出四种 PA 轨迹（持续高水平 41.2%，持续低水平 30.4%，增长型 16.5%，下降型 11.9%），其中 BMI 和身体功能是主要相关因素。所有轨迹的患者报告结局都有可比的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large-sample longitudinal study shows that digital education and exercise therapy can effectively increase physical activity levels in knee/hip osteoarthritis patients, with nearly 60% reaching or maintaining recommended activity levels. This suggests that this intervention model is worthwhile, even for patients with low baseline physical activity, especially those with higher BMI and poorer function.
items.limitation: 该研究基于注册数据，可能存在数据报告偏倚，且未提供关于干预具体内容和依从性的详细信息。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on registry data, which may involve reporting bias, and lacks detailed information on the specific intervention content and adherence.

items.title: Exercise prioritization in frailty: a pathophysiology-informed narrative review for rehabilitation in older adults
items.summary: This narrative review proposes a pathophysiology-informed framework for prioritizing exercise in frail older adults. It suggests tailoring interventions based on dominant physiological limitations (e.g., resistance training for weakness, aerobic training for dyspnea, balance training for gait instability), with multicomponent exercise as a default. Formal validation of this treatment-matching algorithm is needed.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提出了衰弱老年人康复中运动干预的病理生理学导向优先级框架。它提示你，在制定干预方案时，应根据患者最主要的生理储备限制（如肌力不足、呼吸困难或步态不稳）来调整运动类型，确保个性化治疗。
items.titleZh: 衰弱中的运动优先级：一项基于病理生理学的叙述性综述，旨在指导老年人康复。
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述提出了一个基于病理生理学的框架，用于确定衰弱老年人运动的优先级。它建议根据主要的生理限制（例如，针对虚弱进行阻力训练，针对呼吸困难进行有氧训练，针对步态不稳进行平衡训练）来调整干预措施，并将多组分运动作为默认方案。该治疗匹配算法的正式验证仍是下一步研究方向。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review proposes a pathophysiology-informed prioritization framework for exercise interventions in frail older adults. It suggests that when designing intervention programs, you should tailor exercise types based on the patient's most dominant physiological reserve limitations (e.g., muscle weakness, breathlessness, or gait instability) to ensure personalized treatment.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，证据主要来自衰弱队列、肌少症试验及其他老年运动研究的推断，缺乏直接的瓶颈匹配处方对比试验，结论仍需正式验证。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review's evidence primarily extrapolates from frail cohorts, sarcopenia trials, and other older adult exercise studies, lacking direct trials of bottleneck-matched prescriptions, so conclusions require formal validation.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity
